questions.question: On a list, what part of the table, does each column show?
questions.explanation:
Correct
• Option E. A field
• Correct: In ServiceNow, each column in a list corresponds to a field in the underlying table.
• A field represents a single piece of data (e.g., sys_id, created_on, priority) stored in the table.
• Lists display multiple records, and each record shows values for the fields represented by the columns.
Incorrect
• Option A. An element
• Incorrect: While fields can be considered elements of a table, ServiceNow terminology specifically refers to them as fields, not elements.
• Option B. A relationship
• Incorrect: Relationships define how tables connect (e.g., reference fields, many‑to‑many tables). A column does not represent a relationship—it represents a field.
• Option C. A record
• Incorrect: A record is a row in the table, not a column. Each row contains values for all fields (columns).
• Option D. An attribute
• Incorrect: Attributes are metadata properties of fields (e.g., max length, mandatory). A column is not an attribute; it is the field itself.

questions.question: In a typical ServiceNow instance, what types of users are in the system? (Choose one list that orders from 1=most seats to 4=least in amount of seats)
options: 1) System Administrator 2) Delegate Administrator 3) ITIL. User 4) ESS user.
1) ESS user 2) Delegate Administrator 3) ITIL User 4) System Administrator.
1) ESS user 2) ITIL User 3) Delegate Administrator 4) System Administrator.
1) System Administrator 2) ITIL User 3) Delegate Administrator 4) ESS user.
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C: 1) ESS user 2) ITIL User 3) Delegate Administrator 4) System Administrator.
Logic for the ordering (Most to Least):
ESS (Employee Self Service) Users: These are your end-users (employees). They have no specialized roles and use the Service Portal to submit requests or read knowledge articles. In any company, this is the largest group.
ITIL Users: These are the “fulfillers” (IT Staff, HR agents, etc.). They have the itil role to manage incidents, changes, and problems. There are significantly fewer fulfillers than there are employees.
Delegate Administrators: These users have elevated privileges for specific applications or modules (like an HR Admin or a Catalog Admin) but do not have full system control.
System Administrators: These users have the admin role. Per security best practices and the principle of least privilege, this should always be the smallest group to minimize risk to the platform.
Incorrect
Option A & D: 1) System Administrator…
Logic Error: These lists place the System Administrator at the #1 spot (most seats). In a healthy ServiceNow environment, having more Administrators than end-users would be a massive security risk and an extremely expensive licensing mistake.
Option B: 1) ESS user 2) Delegate Administrator 3) ITIL User…
Logic Error: This suggests there are more Delegate Administrators than ITIL fulfillers. In practice, you might have hundreds of ITIL users (Service Desk agents) but only a handful of Delegate Admins managing specific workflows.

questions.question: New records, new groups and modified configuration items what do they have in common?

Tables, Fields, form layout, list layout, Business rules, workflows, system properties, client scripts, script includes, and other scripts
What it does NOT capture is your transactional data like
Changes in Records, Users, Groups, Incidents, Configuration Items, Email

questions.question: Which of the following is a requirement for using the CMDB Data Manager?
options: Configuring the data mapping and migration rules in the CMDB Data Manager.
Setting up the Common Service Data Model (CSDM) environment.
Ensuring there is an active life-cycle rule corresponding to each target class in a life-cycle policy.
Mapping and migrating legacy life-cycle values into the CSDM standard values.
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. Ensuring there is an active life‑cycle rule corresponding to each target class in a life‑cycle policy
• This is correct.
• The CMDB Data Manager requires that life‑cycle rules are defined and active for the target classes.
• These rules ensure that configuration items (CIs) follow proper governance and transitions across their life cycle (e.g., creation, maintenance, retirement).
• Without active life‑cycle rules, the CMDB Data Manager cannot enforce or manage CI data properly.
Incorrect
Option A. Configuring the data mapping and migration rules in the CMDB Data Manager
• Incorrect because while mapping and migration rules are part of data management, they are not a prerequisite requirement for using the CMDB Data Manager.
• The key requirement is the existence of active life‑cycle rules.
Option B. Setting up the Common Service Data Model (CSDM) environment
• Incorrect because CSDM is a framework for organizing services and CIs, but it is not a requirement for using CMDB Data Manager.
• CMDB Data Manager can function without CSDM being fully implemented.
Option D. Mapping and migrating legacy life‑cycle values into the CSDM standard values
• Incorrect because this is a migration activity, not a requirement for enabling CMDB Data Manager.
• It may be part of modernization, but not mandatory for usage.
Option E. Installing the CSDM Activation (com.snc.cmdb.csdm.activation) plugin
• Incorrect because this plugin is related to enabling CSDM features, not specifically required for CMDB Data Manager.
• CMDB Data Manager can operate independently of this plugin.

questions.question: When using Transform Mapping in ServiceNow, how can we dynamically map fields?
options: We can dynamically map source and destination fields by using ServiceNow scripting objects and functionality.
By updating the fields using update sets, we can add/delete/modify the fields using rules and server scripts.
We cannot map dynamically map source and destination fields by using ServiceNow scripting objects and functionality.
We cannot Schedule data imports for mapping the source and destination fields.

Correct
Option A. We can dynamically map source and destination fields by using ServiceNow scripting objects and functionality.
• Correct because ServiceNow allows the use of transform map field mapping scripts (e.g., onBefore, onAfter, or Script field mappings).
• These scripts enable dynamic logic to map source fields to destination fields during data imports.
• This is the standard way to handle complex or conditional mappings in ServiceNow.
Incorrect
Option B. By updating the fields using update sets, we can add/delete/modify the fields using rules and server scripts.
• Incorrect because update sets are used to move configuration changes between instances, not for dynamic field mapping during data transformation.
• Update sets do not provide runtime mapping functionality.
Option C. We cannot dynamically map source and destination fields by using ServiceNow scripting objects and functionality.
• Incorrect because ServiceNow explicitly supports dynamic mapping through scripting.
• This option contradicts the platform’s capabilities.
Option D. We cannot schedule data imports for mapping the source and destination fields.
• Incorrect because ServiceNow allows scheduled data imports.
• Scheduling imports is a common practice, and it works alongside transform maps and dynamic mappings.

questions.question: Which table is used to store configuration items?
questions.explanation:
The correct table used to store configuration items in ServiceNow is:
cmdb_ci
Here‘s why:
cmdb_ci: This is the standard table within the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) specifically designed to store information about Configuration Items (CIs) in ServiceNow. It holds details like hardware, software, services, and other IT assets that make up your infrastructure.
Incorrect Options:
cmdb: While CMDB refers to the Configuration Management Database itself, cmdb_ci is the specific table within that database for storing CI data.
configuration_item & sys_configuration_item: These terms likely don‘t represent actual tables in a standard ServiceNow instance.
sys_ci: While sys_prefix is commonly used for system tables, cmdb_ci is the established table name for CIs.
Understanding CIs and cmdb_ci:
CIs are essential components in ServiceNow‘s CMDB, providing a central repository for information about your IT infrastructure. The cmdb_ci table stores a wealth of attributes for each CI, including:
Type (e.g., server, software, network device)
Model name
Serial number
IP address
Relationships with other CIs
Custom fields specific to your organization
By effectively managing CIs within the cmdb_ci table, you gain a comprehensive understanding of your IT environment, facilitating tasks like:
Incident management
Change management
Asset management
Impact analysis

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding knowledge management workflows?
options: One workflow should be used for all knowledge bases
The same workflow that is used for publishing should be used for retirement
There are workflows available OOTB but you can create your own
None of the listed answers is correct
Workflows can be used only for publishing article but not for retirement
questions.explanation:
The correct statement regarding knowledge management workflows is:
There are workflows available OOTB but you can create your own
Here‘s why:
Out-of-the-Box (OOTB) Workflows: ServiceNow and many other knowledge management platforms offer pre-built workflows to streamline common processes. These might include workflows for creating, reviewing, approving, and publishing knowledge articles.
Custom Workflows: While OOTB workflows offer a good starting point, organizations can tailor workflows to their specific needs. You can create custom workflows for different knowledge base categories, approval processes, or retirement procedures.
Let‘s break down why the other options are incorrect:
One workflow for all knowledge bases: This approach lacks flexibility. Different knowledge bases might have varying requirements, benefiting from specialized workflows.
Same workflow for publishing and retirement: While some overlap might exist, publishing focuses on creating and making content available, while retirement involves archiving or removing outdated information. These often require distinct steps and approvals.
Workflows only for publishing: Workflows can manage the entire knowledge article lifecycle, including retirement processes for removing articles that are no longer relevant.
Benefits of Custom Workflows:
Improved Efficiency: Streamline knowledge creation, review, and approval processes.
Enhanced Consistency: Ensure all knowledge articles adhere to quality standards.
Better Governance: Define clear ownership and accountability for knowledge content.
Conclusion:
Leveraging OOTB workflows combined with the ability to create custom workflows empowers organizations to establish a robust knowledge management strategy.

questions.question: What type of platform is provided by Now Platform?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. Application Platform as‑a‑Service (aPaaS)
• The Now Platform is designed as an application platform as‑a‑service.
• It allows organizations to build, deploy, and manage applications in the cloud without worrying about infrastructure.
• ServiceNow provides tools for workflow automation, integration, and extensibility, making it aPaaS rather than pure SaaS or IaaS.
• This is the correct answer for the exam.
Incorrect
Option B. Infrastructure as‑a‑Service (IaaS)
• IaaS provides raw compute, storage, and networking resources.
• ServiceNow does not expose infrastructure directly; instead, it provides a higher‑level application platform.
• Therefore, this option is incorrect.
Option C. None of the listed answers
• This is incorrect because the Now Platform clearly fits the definition of aPaaS.
Option D. Software as‑a‑Service (SaaS)
• While ServiceNow applications (like ITSM, HR, CSM) are delivered as SaaS, the Now Platform itself is categorized as aPaaS because it enables building and extending applications.
• SaaS is too narrow to describe the platform’s capabilities.

questions.question: Any table in ServiceNow can be extended
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. False
• This is correct because not all tables in ServiceNow can be extended.
• Core system tables such as System tables (e.g., sys_user, sys_audit, sys_db_object) and certain non-extensible base tables are restricted from extension to preserve platform integrity.
• Only tables that are designed to be extensible (like Task, CMDB, or Incident) can be extended to create custom functionality.
Incorrect
Option B. True
• Incorrect because this implies that every table in ServiceNow can be extended, which is not the case.
• Extending all tables would risk breaking system functionality and is explicitly prevented by ServiceNow’s architecture.

questions.question: If a table is extended but itself is not extending another table, it is called a ……….
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. Base table
• Correct because a base table is the original table that is not extending any other table.
• Other tables can extend it, but it itself does not extend another.
• This is the foundational concept in systems like ServiceNow, where base tables serve as the starting point for extensions.
Incorrect
Option A. Extending table
• Incorrect because an extending table is one that extends another table.
• The question specifies the table is extended but does not extend another, so this does not apply.
Option B. Master table
• Incorrect because “master table” is not the proper terminology in this context.
• While it might imply a primary table, the correct technical term is base table.
Option D. Interface
• Incorrect because an interface is not a table type.
• Interfaces define communication or integration points, not table inheritance.
Option E. Parent table
• Incorrect because a parent table is one that other tables extend from.
• The question specifies the table itself is extended but does not extend another, so it is not a parent.
Option F. Core table
• Incorrect because “core table” is not the defined term for this scenario.
• Core tables may exist in some systems, but the precise answer here is base table.

questions.question: List Editor has the feature that allows editing a field on multiple rows
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. True
• This is correct because the List Editor in ServiceNow allows inline editing of fields directly in a list view.
• Users can select multiple rows and update the same field value across those rows simultaneously.
• This feature improves efficiency by avoiding the need to open each record’s form individually.
Incorrect
Option B. False
• Incorrect because the List Editor does indeed support editing fields across multiple rows.
• Saying “False” ignores the functionality that ServiceNow provides for bulk inline editing.

questions.question: A manager wants to view a snapshot of month end Sales performance data, as compared to Sales targets. In addition, the manager wants to be able to see those monthly numbers trended over time and forecasted into the future. What capability do you suggest for this manager?
options: Scheduled Reports, a custom snapshot table, and a Projection report
Scheduled Reports, a custom snapshot table, and a Trend report
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. Performance Analytics
• Correct because Performance Analytics (PA) in ServiceNow provides:
• Snapshots of data at specific points in time (e.g., month‑end sales).
• Trend analysis to visualize performance over time.
• Forecasting capabilities to project future performance based on historical data.
• This directly meets the manager’s requirements for snapshots, trends, and forecasts in one integrated solution.
Incorrect
Option A. Scheduled Reports + custom snapshot + Projection report
• Incorrect because while scheduled reports and custom tables can capture snapshots, this approach is manual and fragmented.
• Projection reports are limited compared to PA’s built‑in forecasting.
Option B. Scheduled Reports + custom snapshot + Trend report
• Incorrect because this only covers snapshots and trends, but not forecasting.
• The manager explicitly requires forecasting into the future.
Option D. Scheduled Reports and Excel
• Incorrect because exporting to Excel is manual and lacks real‑time analytics.
• Forecasting and trend visualization would require external tools, not native ServiceNow capabilities.
Option E. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Incorrect because KPIs are metrics, not a full analytics solution.
• KPIs show current performance but do not provide snapshots, trends, or forecasts.

questions.question: What are advantages of using Flow Designer? (Choose 4 answers)
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option B: Less manual scripting
• Correct because Flow Designer provides a low-code/no-code interface to build automation, reducing the need for custom scripts.
Option D: Reduces technical debt
• Correct because using Flow Designer avoids heavy reliance on custom scripts and legacy workflows, leading to cleaner, maintainable solutions.
Option E: Smooth integration with 3rd party systems
• Correct because Flow Designer supports IntegrationHub spokes, enabling seamless connections with external systems (e.g., Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira).
Option F: Complements the Integration Store
• Correct because Flow Designer works directly with the IntegrationHub Store, allowing developers to leverage pre-built integrations and extend functionality.
Incorrect
Option A: Supports legacy workflows
• Incorrect because Flow Designer is designed to replace legacy workflows, not support them.
• Legacy Workflow Editor is being phased out in favor of Flow Designer.
Option C: Enables complicated scripting
• Incorrect because Flow Designer’s purpose is to reduce scripting, not encourage it.
• While scripting can be added via Action steps, the main advantage is simplifying automation without complex code.

questions.question: What policies are applied to all data entered into the platform: via form (UI), Import Sets, or Web Services?
questions.explanation:
Reference: Data Policies vs UI Policies
Data policies are similar to UI Policies, but UI policies only apply to data entered on a form through the standard browser. Data policies can apply rules to all data entered into the system, including data brought in through import sets or web services and data entered through the mobile UI.

questions.question: Which flow components allow you to specify when a flow should be run?
questions.explanation: Reference: Flows

questions.question: If you have the Impersonate role, what type of user are you not able to impersonate?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. Extended Security Admin This is correct because ServiceNow restricts impersonation of Extended Security Admin users. These accounts have elevated privileges tied to system security, and impersonating them could compromise sensitive configurations or bypass critical safeguards. Even with the Impersonate role, you cannot impersonate this type of user.
Incorrect
Option B. Security Desk Users Incorrect because these are standard users with specific functional roles. They can be impersonated if you have the Impersonate role.
Option C. Special Agents Incorrect because this is not a restricted role in ServiceNow. Users with this designation can be impersonated.
Option D. Government Customers Incorrect because customer accounts are not restricted from impersonation by default. They can be impersonated for troubleshooting or support purposes.
Option E. Security Incident Response Users Incorrect because these users are tied to the Security Incident Response application but are not restricted from impersonation.

questions.question: Which ServiceNow resource can be used as a blueprint to map your IT Services to ServiceNow?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option E. Common Services Data Model (CSDM)
• Correct because the CSDM provides a standardized blueprint for mapping IT services to ServiceNow.
• It defines how services, applications, and infrastructure should be represented in the CMDB, ensuring consistency across ITSM, ITOM, and other ServiceNow products.
• Using CSDM helps organizations align their IT services with ServiceNow best practices, making it the right answer for this exam question.
Incorrect
Option A. Configuration Management Database (CMDB)
• Incorrect because while the CMDB stores configuration items (CIs) and relationships, it is not itself a blueprint.
• The CMDB is the repository, whereas the CSDM provides the model/blueprint for structuring services within the CMDB.
Option B. NowLearning
• Incorrect because NowLearning is ServiceNow’s training platform. It provides educational resources but does not serve as a blueprint for mapping IT services.
Option C. ServiceNow Wiki
• Incorrect because the Wiki is a documentation resource. It offers guidance but is not a formal blueprint for service mapping.
Option D. Service Mapping Guided Setup
• Incorrect because Service Mapping Guided Setup helps configure service mapping but relies on the CSDM blueprint. It is a tool for implementation, not the foundational model.
Option F. IT Service Management (ITSM)
• Incorrect because ITSM is a set of processes and applications for managing IT services. It is not a blueprint for mapping services into ServiceNow.

questions.question: What tool allows you to drag and drop to specify links between source fields on an Import Set table and destination fields on any ServiceNow table?
questions.explanation: The mapping assist utility provides a visually intuitive environment for specifying mapping between import set fields and production table fields. The mapping assist utility makes it possible to map a single source field (field on an import set table) to multiple destination fields (fields on a production table).

questions.question: What are the steps for importing data using an import set?
options: Identify source; Import transform map; Run transformer; Verify import
Load the data; Create transform map; Transform data; Clean up import table
Select source file; Run AutoMap; Transform data; Clean up target table
Set up LDAP; Test map; Create update set; Run import; Apply update set
questions.explanation:
Import Set Table: A table that acts as a staging location for records imported from a data source before transforming those records. Fields on these tables are generated automatically based on imported data and should not be modified manually.
Reference: Loading Data in import set table and steps thereafter

questions.question: You are creating a catalog item for ordering a new desktop computer. The computers have these options: Color: Black or Silver RAM: 32 MB or 64 MB Keyboard: Standard or Ergonomic Monitor: 24 inch or 32 inch How would you add these options to the catalog item form?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. Add variables
• Correct because in ServiceNow, catalog item options (like color, RAM, keyboard, monitor) are added as variables.
• Variables define the input fields that users see when ordering catalog items.
• Each option (e.g., Color) would be a variable, and the possible values (Black, Silver) would be choices within that variable.
Incorrect
Option A. Add choices
• Incorrect because “choices” are used within variables, not directly added to the catalog item form.
• You must first create a variable (e.g., Color), then define its choices (Black, Silver).
Option B. Add UI options
• Incorrect because “UI options” is not a ServiceNow catalog item configuration method.
• Catalog item customization relies on variables, not UI options.
Option D. Add fields
• Incorrect because catalog items do not use standard database fields for user input.
• Instead, ServiceNow uses variables to capture user selections.

questions.question: Here is an example of the criteria set for a Knowledge Base.· Companies: ACME North America· Departments: HR· Groups: ACME Managers· Match All: YesIn this example, what user would have access to this Knowledge Base?
options: Members of the ACME Managers group, and HR department, regardless of geography
Employee of ACME North America, who are members of HR Department or the ACME Managers group
Members of the ACME Manager group, who are also members of the HR Department and part of ACME North America
Users which are members of either ACME North America, or HR Department, or ACME Managers group.
questions.explanation: Self-Explanatory

questions.question: For a customer’s inventory application, several inventory specifications fields are needed on an inventory ticket. These tickets will be assigned to inventory support team members. How would you start to implement this requirement?
options: Create inventory table as a new base Table. Then add inventory specifications fields, as needed
Create inventory table with the inventory specification fields. Then create view between the inventory and the Task table
Create inventory table with the inventory specification fields. Then create many to many relationships between the inventory and the Task table
Create inventory table as an extended table from the Task Table. Then add the inventory specification fields, as needed.
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option D: Create inventory table as an extended table from the Task Table. Then add the inventory specification fields, as needed
• This is the correct answer.
• In ServiceNow, when you need tickets that behave like tasks (assigned, tracked, worked on), the best practice is to extend the Task table.
• By extending Task, the new inventory table inherits all task-related functionality (assignment, SLA, workflow, etc.).
• You can then add custom inventory specification fields to meet the business requirement.
• This ensures consistency with ServiceNow’s data model and avoids duplicating task-related logic.
Incorrect
Option A: Create inventory table as a new base Table. Then add inventory specifications fields, as needed
• Incorrect because creating a new base table would not inherit task-related functionality.
• You would lose built-in features like assignment, workflow, and reporting, requiring unnecessary customization.
Option B: Create inventory table with the inventory specification fields. Then create view between the inventory and the Task table
• Incorrect because views only provide a way to display combined data.
• They do not provide the functional inheritance needed for tickets to behave like tasks.
Option C: Create inventory table with the inventory specification fields. Then create many-to-many relationships between the inventory and the Task table
• Incorrect because many-to-many relationships are used for linking records, not for inheriting task functionality.
• This approach would complicate the design and still not provide task-like behavior for inventory tickets.

questions.question: Which type of scripts run in the browser?
questions.explanation:
ServiceNow Client scripts are Javascript that runs on the client-side (the user‘s web browser) and instead of the server (on the server).
UI Policies are client-side logic that governs form and form field behavior

questions.question: What attributes you can manage using System Properties > Basic Configuration UI16 ( Choose 5 answer)
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option B: Browser tab title
• Correct because you can configure the text that appears in the browser tab for the ServiceNow instance.
Option C: Base Theme
• Correct because UI16 allows administrators to set the base theme for the instance, controlling the overall look and feel.
Option D: Module text color
• Correct because you can customize the color of module text to align with branding or improve readability.
Option E: Header background color
• Correct because UI16 configuration allows changing the header background color to match organizational branding.
Option F: Banner Image
• Correct because you can upload and configure a banner image that appears in the header of the ServiceNow interface.
Incorrect
Option A: Default calendar
• Incorrect because the Basic Configuration UI16 does not manage calendar settings.
• Calendar configuration is handled separately in ServiceNow, not through UI16 basic properties.

questions.question: Which type of field allows you to enter freely using letters, numbers, and special characters?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option E: String
• This is the correct answer.
• In ServiceNow, the String field type allows free-form entry of letters, numbers, and special characters.
• It is the most flexible field type for capturing unstructured input.
• String fields can be configured as single-line or multi-line, but the underlying type is still String.
Incorrect
Option A: Multi line text
• Incorrect because this is a presentation style of a String field, not a separate field type.
• It allows multiple lines of input but is still fundamentally a String field.
Option B: Single line text
• Incorrect because this is also a presentation style of a String field.
• It restricts input to one line but does not define the actual field type.
Option C: Open text
• Incorrect because “Open text” is not a defined ServiceNow field type.
• It is a descriptive term, not a technical option in ServiceNow.
Option D: Text
• Incorrect because “Text” is not a distinct field type in ServiceNow.
• The actual field type is String, which covers both single-line and multi-line text entry.

questions.question: What is a set of conditions applied to a table list to show a subset of the data?
questions.explanation: A filter restricts what records appear in a list by providing a set of conditions each record must meet to be included in the list.

questions.question: Which admin role is required to make changes to High Security Settings?
questions.explanation: The security_admin role is an elevated privilege role provided with High Security Settings that lets users create and change access controls and change High Security Settings.

questions.question: How are users and groups related
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. Many to Many
• Correct because in ServiceNow, users and groups have a many-to-many relationship.
• A single user can belong to multiple groups, and a single group can contain multiple users.
• This relationship is managed through the sys_user_grmember table, which maps users to groups.
• This design allows flexible role assignment and access control.
Incorrect
Option B. One to Many
• Incorrect because this would imply that one user can only belong to one group, which is not true.
• ServiceNow allows users to be members of multiple groups simultaneously.
Option C. One to One
• Incorrect because this would mean each user is tied to exactly one group, and each group has exactly one user.
• This is too restrictive and does not reflect ServiceNow’s group membership model.
Option D. Onto to Many
• Incorrect because “Onto to Many” is not a valid relationship type in ServiceNow or database terminology.
• This is simply a distractor option.

questions.question: When importing data, what happens to imported rows, if no coalesce field is specified?
options: All rows are treated as new records, but errors will be flagged in the import log
Duplicate rows are rejected from the import
All rows are treated as new records. No existing records are updated
All rows are rejected from the import, as coalesce field is required
questions.explanation:
If no coalesce is defined, all imported rows are treated as new records. No existing records are updated.
Reference: Updating using coalesce

questions.question: Which one of the following statement applies to a set of fields when they are coalesced during an import?
options: If a match is not found using the coalesce fields, the system does not create a Transform Map
If a match is found using the coalesce fields, the system creates a new record
If a match is found using the coalesce fields, the existing record is updated with the information being imported
If a match is not found using the coalesce fields, the existing record is updated with the information being imported
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C: If a match is found using the coalesce fields, the existing record is updated with the information being imported
• This is the correct answer.
• In ServiceNow, coalesce fields are used during imports to determine whether an incoming record should update an existing record or create a new one.
• If a match is found on the coalesce field(s), the system updates the existing record with the new data.
• If no match is found, a new record is created.
• This ensures data integrity and prevents duplicate records.
Incorrect
Option A: If a match is not found using the coalesce fields, the system does not create a Transform Map
• Incorrect because the Transform Map is created independently of whether matches are found.
• The Transform Map defines how data is imported, not whether it is created.
Option B: If a match is found using the coalesce fields, the system creates a new record
• Incorrect because if a match is found, the system updates the existing record, not creates a new one.
• New records are only created when no match is found.
Option D: If a match is not found using the coalesce fields, the existing record is updated with the information being imported
• Incorrect because if no match is found, there is no existing record to update.
• Instead, the system creates a new record.

questions.question: What can be used to automatically populate fields in a form?
questions.explanation:
Templates simplify the process of submitting new records by populating fields automatically.
Reference: Form Template

questions.question: Which of the following protects applications by identifying and restricting access to available files and data?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option D. Application Scope
• Correct because Application Scope in ServiceNow defines the boundaries of an application.
• It protects applications by restricting access to files, data, and resources within that scope, ensuring that only authorized components can interact with the application.
• This mechanism prevents unintended access or modification from other applications, thereby safeguarding the integrity of the app.
Incorrect
Option A. Application Configuration
• Incorrect because configuration refers to settings and parameters that define how an application behaves.
• While important for functionality, it does not inherently restrict access to files or data.
Option B. Access Control Rules
• Incorrect in this context because Access Control Rules (ACLs) protect records and fields at the database level, not the application boundary itself.
• ACLs are about user permissions, not application-level protection of files and data.
Option C. Verbose Log
• Incorrect because verbose logging is used for troubleshooting and monitoring.
• Logs provide visibility but do not restrict or protect access to application files or data.

questions.question: A Service Catalog project will involve building 80 catalog items. For each of the catalog items, the following fields will be mandatory on the forms:· Requested for· Requested by· Approving manager· Delivery InstructionsAll of the other variables will be specific to the individual catalog item. What features would you use when designing the catalog item form?
options: Create an Order Guide, which includes all variables, then copy and hide variables as needed.
Create one Variable Set for the four variables, then add that variable set to each of the 80 catalog items
Create a Variable Set Template, then apply to all of the catalog items
Create a Record Producer that contains the four fields, then add to the record producer related list on the Catalog items
Create a Flow Designer Action, with Variable Set Data Pill, then apply flow to all of the 80 catalog items
questions.explanation:
Reference: Create variable set
All these fields would be already there while creating catalog items.

questions.question: Which helps the agents to have real-time collaboration with others based around a Workspace task-based or interaction-based record?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option B. Side bar
• Correct because the Agent Workspace Side bar provides real-time collaboration tools such as chat, comments, and activity streams.
• It is specifically designed to allow agents to collaborate with other team members while working on a task-based or interaction-based record in Workspace.
• This ensures agents can share context and updates instantly without leaving the record.
Incorrect
Option A. Virtual Agent
• Incorrect because Virtual Agent is a chatbot interface that helps end users resolve issues through automated conversations.
• It is not a collaboration tool for agents working together in Workspace.
Option C. Now Support Community
• Incorrect because the Now Support Community is an external platform for peer-to-peer support and knowledge sharing among ServiceNow customers.
• It is not integrated into Workspace for real-time agent collaboration.
Option D. Help menu
• Incorrect because the Help menu provides documentation and guidance for using ServiceNow features.
• It does not enable real-time collaboration between agents.

questions.question: A manager wants to run a report showing how many Service Requests have been fulfilled for Business Cards, since the beginning of the year. What table would they select for building this report?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option B. Requested Item [sc_req_item]
• This is the correct table to use.
• Each Service Request submitted through the Service Catalog generates one or more Requested Items (sc_req_item).
• The fulfillment status (e.g., closed/fulfilled) is tracked at the Requested Item level, not at the request header.
• Therefore, to report on fulfilled requests for a specific catalog item (Business Cards), the manager should use the sc_req_item table.
Incorrect
Option A. Request [sc_req]
• Incorrect because this table stores the overall request record (the header).
• It does not track fulfillment of individual items.
Option C. Task [task]
• Incorrect because this is a generic base table for all tasks in ServiceNow.
• Too broad and not specific to Service Catalog reporting.
Option D. Catalog Item [sc_cat_item]
• Incorrect because this table defines the catalog items themselves (metadata like name, description, availability).
• It does not store request or fulfillment data.
Option E. Catalog Task [sc_task]
• Incorrect because this table stores tasks generated to fulfill requested items.
• While related, it is not the right table to count fulfilled service requests.
Option F. Service Catalog [sc_catalog]
• Incorrect because this table stores the catalog definitions (collections of items).
• It does not track request fulfillment.

questions.question: Your customer requires that they be able to monitor which users are performing impersonations in their instance. What would you do to meet that requirement?
options: Add the role Log Write [an_log_write] to the Impersonator Group
Create user update set for impersonation tracking
On the Impersonator role record, right click and select Create Log
From User Icon, select Elevate Roles
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option B: Activate the glide.sys.log_impersonation script (property)
The Logic: By default, ServiceNow logs impersonations in the System Log, but specific detailed logging is controlled by system properties.
The Mechanism: The property glide.sys.log_impersonation (often referred to as a script-driven property in older documentation or exam banks) must be set to true. Once active, every time an administrator impersonates another user, a log entry is created that captures the “Impersonator” and the “Impersonated” user.
Where to view results: After activation, you can navigate to System Logs > Events or System Logs > Transactions to monitor these activities.
Incorrect
Option A: Add the role Log Write [an_log_write] to the Impersonator Group
Reasoning: There is no standard “Log Write” role required to trigger impersonation logging. System logging is a platform-level function handled by the system, not something granted to a group to perform.
Option C: Create user update set for impersonation tracking
Reasoning: Update Sets are used for moving configurations and customizations between instances (e.g., from Dev to Prod). They are not used for real-time monitoring or auditing of user activities.
Option D: On the Impersonator role record, right click and select Create Log
Reasoning: This is a fabricated step. You cannot “Create Log” by right-clicking a role record in the dictionary or role list. Logging configuration is handled via System Properties or System Logs.
Option E: From User Icon, select Elevate Roles
Reasoning: Elevated Roles (like security_admin) are used to gain higher-level permissions for specific sessions, such as modifying Access Control Lists (ACLs). While a security_admin might be the one to activate the logging property, selecting “Elevate Roles” does not fulfill the requirement to monitor other users’ impersonations.

questions.question: Which feature assists in understanding the Service Portal user experience better?
questions.explanation:
Correct
• Option D. User Experience Analytics
• Correct because User Experience Analytics (UXA) provides insights into how users interact with the Service Portal.
• It helps identify user journeys, friction points, and behavior patterns, allowing administrators to improve the portal’s usability and overall experience.
• This feature is specifically designed to analyze end‑user interactions, making it the right answer.
Incorrect
• Option A. Employee Centre Portal
• Incorrect because this is a portal interface for employees, not a feature that provides analytics or insights into user experience.
• Option B. Service Portal Usage Overview Dashboard
• Incorrect because while it shows usage statistics, it does not provide detailed analytics on user experience behaviors such as friction points or navigation issues.
• Option C. Performance Analytics
• Incorrect because Performance Analytics focuses on KPIs, trends, and reporting across processes, not specifically on Service Portal user experience.

questions.question: Which operation is a record type access control list (ACL) that governs reports in dashboards and are enabled by default?
questions.explanation:
The report_view operation is a record type access control list (ACL) that restricts access to reports. Only users who have one of the required roles can view reports that contain the restricted resource.
There are two kinds of report_view access control lists (ACLs): report_view table ACLs and report_view field ACLs. Report_view table ACLs prevent users from viewing report content based on the table specified in the ACL. Report_view field ACLs prevent users from viewing reports that use the field specified in the ACL in the group by, row, column or aggregation.

questions.question: Which role can administrators grant to users in order for them to view the configuration and execution details of only flows and subflows?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. fd_read_flows
• This is the correct role.
• The fd_read_flows role allows users to view configuration and execution details of flows and subflows only, without granting broader Flow Designer administrative privileges.
• It is specifically scoped to read‑only access for flows/subflows, making it the right choice for this requirement.
Incorrect
Option A. fd_read
• Incorrect. This role provides read access to Flow Designer but is broader and not limited to flows and subflows.
• It does not specifically restrict visibility to only flows/subflows.
Option B. fd_read_operations
• Incorrect. This role is related to operational aspects of Flow Designer but does not provide the targeted visibility into flows and subflows.
• It is not the designated role for viewing configuration and execution details of flows/subflows.
Option D. fd_admin_designer
• Incorrect. This is an administrator role for Flow Designer.
• It grants full privileges, including creating and editing flows, which goes beyond the requirement of simply viewing configuration and execution details.

questions.question: The display sequence is controlled in the Service Catalog Item using which of the following?
options: The Default Value field in the Catalog Item form
The Sequence field in the Catalog Item form
The Order field in the Variable form
The Choice field in the Variable form
questions.explanation: An order on variable set decides on where to position the variables on the catalog item form. So, the display sequence is controlled in a Service Catalog Item using Order field in variable form..

questions.question: CMDB Data Manager is a wizard-like tool that provides a comprehensive solution for managing configuration items. Which of the following indicates how CMDB Data Manager operates? Select 2 Answers from the below options.
options: It rarely copes with rapid changes in a cloud-based world.
It helps maintain the CMDB healthy and efficient.
It can only manage small to medium CMDBs.
questions.explanation:
Let’s analyze each option in the context of CMDB Data Manager:
• It rarely copes with rapid changes in a cloud-based world.
• This is generally incorrect. Modern CMDB tools, including those with Data Manager capabilities, are designed to handle dynamic environments, including cloud-based ones. They often include features for automated discovery and updates.
• It operates in bulk.
• This is correct. CMDB Data Manager tools are designed to handle large volumes of data, allowing for bulk updates, imports, and reconciliations of configuration items.
• It helps maintain the CMDB healthy and efficient.
• This is correct. The primary purpose of CMDB Data Manager is to ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy within the CMDB, leading to a healthier and more efficient configuration management process.
• It can only manage small to medium CMDBs.
• This is generally incorrect. Modern CMDB tools, and their Data Manager features, are made to handle enterprise sized CMDB’s.
Therefore, the two correct answers are:
• It operates in bulk.
• It helps maintain the CMDB healthy and efficient.
