questions.explanation: Only tasks use states, so they can be moved to closed. We can work on it.

questions.question: Which one of the following statements describes the purpose of a Service Catalog flow?
options: A Service Catalog flow is used to drive complex fulfillment processes and sends notifications to defined users or groups
Although a Service Catalog flow cannot send notifications, the flow drives complex fulfillment processes
A Service Catalog flow generates three basic components: item variable types, tasks, and notifications
A Service Catalog flow generates three basic components: item variable types, tasks, and approvals
questions.explanation:
Let’s analyze each statement about the purpose of a Service Catalog flow:
• A Service Catalog flow is used to drive complex fulfillment processes and sends notifications to defined users or groups:
• This is the most accurate description. Service Catalog flows are designed to automate and orchestrate complex fulfillment processes, which often involve tasks, approvals, and notifications.
Although a Service Catalog flow cannot send notifications, the flow drives complex fulfillment processes:
• This is incorrect. Service Catalog flows are a core part of ServiceNow Flow Designer, which readily supports the sending of notifications.
• A Service Catalog flow generates three basic components: item variable types, tasks, and notifications:
• Flows use item variable types, and they generate tasks and notifications, but they don’t generate the variable types, the variables are used within the flow.
• A Service Catalog flow generates three basic components: item variable types, tasks, and approvals:
• Similar to the previous option, flows use variable types, and they include tasks and approvals. Again though, they utilize these components, they do not create them intrinsically.
Therefore, the statement that best describes the purpose of a Service Catalog flow is:
• A Service Catalog flow is used to drive complex fulfillment processes and sends notifications to defined users or groups

questions.question: There is no need to create new Import Set for every time you need to import data, you can reuse the Import Set if you‘re importing data with the same columns
questions.explanation:
Correct:
Option B. True
Import Sets in ServiceNow are reusable staging tables designed for repeated data imports with identical column structures. Once created with the correct field mapping, the same Import Set table can be reused for subsequent imports matching the original schema.
Incorrect
option A. FALSE
Import Sets support reuse for efficiency. Creating new Import Set tables for every import duplicates staging infrastructure unnecessarily when column structure remains consistent.

questions.question: Which module can be used to change the default date/time formatting?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. System Properties > Basic Configuration UI16
• Reason: In ServiceNow, the Basic Configuration UI16 module allows administrators to configure date/time formats, number formats, and other UI16 display settings.
• This is the correct place to change the default date/time formatting for the instance.
• It aligns with CSA exam expectations, since UI16 is the standard interface where formatting properties are managed.
Incorrect
Option A. System Properties > Date/Time
• Incorrect because this module is not used for formatting changes.
• It deals with system‑level date/time behaviors (like time zones or scheduling), not the default display format.
Option B. System Properties > Configuration
• Incorrect because this module is for general system configuration properties, not specifically date/time formatting.
Option D. System Properties > General
• Incorrect because this module contains general system properties (like company name, URL, etc.), not date/time formatting.

questions.question: What ServiceNow API will you use to retrieve the incident data in the server script?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option B. GlideRecord
• GlideRecord is the correct API for retrieving incident data in a server-side script.
• It allows querying, inserting, updating, and deleting records in ServiceNow tables.
• Example usage:
javascript
var gr = new GlideRecord('incident');
gr.query();
while (gr.next()) {
gs.info(gr.number + " - " + gr.short_description);
}
This is the standard way to retrieve incident data programmatically in server scripts.
Incorrect
Option A. g_form
• g_form is a client-side API used in UI scripts and client scripts to interact with form fields.
• It cannot be used in server-side scripts to retrieve incident data.
Option C. GlideApi
• GlideApi is not a valid ServiceNow API. This option is incorrect because it does not exist in the ServiceNow platform.
Option D. GlideData
• GlideData is also not a valid ServiceNow API. It is not used for retrieving records in server scripts.

questions.question: What module in the Service Catalog application does an Administrator access to begin creating a new catalog item?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. Maintain Items
Correct because in the Service Catalog application, administrators use the Maintain Items module to begin creating new catalog items. This module provides the interface to define item details, workflows, variables, and approvals. It is the standard entry point for catalog item creation in ServiceNow.
Incorrect
Option B. Items
Incorrect because the Items module is used to view or manage existing catalog items, not to create new ones. It does not provide the full configuration options needed for new item creation.
Option C. Content Items
Incorrect because Content Items are used for static information (like knowledge articles or links) in the catalog, not for creating functional catalog items with workflows and variables.
Option D. Catalog Item
Incorrect because while “Catalog Item” refers to the object being created, there is no separate module named “Catalog Item” for administrators to start the creation process. The correct module is Maintain Items.

questions.question: Which of the following is used to categorize, flag, and locate records?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. Tags
Correct because in ServiceNow, Tags are used to categorize, flag, and locate records. They allow users to apply labels to records, making it easier to search, filter, and organize information across the platform. Tags are flexible and user-driven, enabling quick identification and grouping of related records.
Incorrect
Option A. Search
Incorrect because Search is used to find records based on keywords or conditions, but it does not categorize or flag records. It is a retrieval mechanism, not a categorization tool.
Option B. Favorites
Incorrect because Favorites allow users to bookmark frequently used applications or modules, not individual records. They are for navigation convenience, not categorization of records.
Option D. Bookmarks
Incorrect because Bookmarks are used to save links to specific pages or records for quick access. They do not provide categorization or flagging functionality.

questions.question: The ServiceNow platform includes which types of interfaces? Select 3 answers.
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. Now Mobile Apps
• Correct because ServiceNow provides Now Mobile Apps for iOS and Android, enabling users to access workflows, approvals, and requests on the go.
Option C. Service Portals
• Correct because Service Portals are web interfaces that allow customers and employees to interact with ServiceNow services in a user‑friendly way.
• They are customizable and widely used for self‑service.
Option E. Now Platform® User Interfaces
• Correct because the Now Platform UI (including the standard web interface and workspace experiences) is a core interface for interacting with ServiceNow.
• It provides access to applications, records, and dashboards.
Incorrect
Option B. Back Office Dashboard
• Incorrect because while dashboards exist in ServiceNow, “Back Office Dashboard” is not a defined interface type in the platform.
Option D. Agent Control Center
• Incorrect because ServiceNow does not have a specific interface called “Agent Control Center.” Agents typically use Agent Workspace instead.
Option F. Field Service Taskboard
• Incorrect because although ServiceNow supports Field Service Management, the “Taskboard” is not considered a primary platform interface type.

questions.question: Which module can be used to create assignment lookup rules?
options: System Policy > Rules > Assignments Lookup Rules
questions.explanation:
Correct
• Option B. System Policy > Rules > Assignments Lookup Rules
• Correct because in ServiceNow, assignment lookup rules are created under the System Policy > Rules module.
• This is the proper navigation path in the application navigator to define rules that automatically assign tasks (like incidents or requests) based on conditions.
Incorrect
• Option A. System > Rules > Assignments Lookup Rules
• Incorrect because there is no such module path in ServiceNow. The correct path is under System Policy, not just System.
• Option C. System > Assignments Lookup Rules
• Incorrect because this path does not exist in the ServiceNow navigation. Assignment lookup rules are not directly under “System.”
• Option D. System Policy > Assignments Lookup Rules
• Incorrect because while it references System Policy, it misses the Rules submodule. The correct path is System Policy > Rules > Assignments Lookup Rules.

questions.question: Which admin role is required to make changes to High Security Settings?
questions.explanation:
Correct
• Option C. security_admin Correct because the security_admin role is explicitly required to make changes to High Security Settings in ServiceNow. This role provides elevated privileges for managing sensitive security configurations, ensuring that only authorized administrators can modify these critical settings.
Incorrect
• Option A. admin Incorrect because while the admin role grants broad administrative privileges, it does not automatically allow changes to High Security Settings. The security_admin role is specifically required for this purpose.
• Option B. hi_sec_admin Incorrect because this role does not exist in ServiceNow. It is a distractor option.
• Option D. acl_admin Incorrect because the acl_admin role is related to managing Access Control Lists (ACLs), not High Security Settings.
• Option E. sec_admin Incorrect because this role does not exist in ServiceNow. It is another distractor option.

questions.question: How to combine data from two tables in a report?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. Database View
• Correct because Database Views in ServiceNow allow you to combine data from multiple tables into a single logical view.
• Reports can then be built on top of these views to display combined data.
• This is the standard and supported way to join data across tables for reporting purposes in ServiceNow.
Incorrect
Option A. Join
• Incorrect because ServiceNow does not support direct SQL joins in reporting.
• Joins are abstracted through Database Views, not manually defined in reports.
Option B. Many to Many
• Incorrect because Many‑to‑Many relationships are used to relate records between tables, not to combine data for reporting.
• They help with relationships but do not provide a reporting mechanism.
Option D. Related Lists
• Incorrect because Related Lists show associated records on a form, not in a report.
• They are useful for navigation but cannot combine data into a single report output.

questions.question: What do you need to do before you can use an Application-based trigger in your flow?
options: Assign Application trigger role [sn_app_trigger_write] to SME
Activate application spoke, and plug-ins as needed
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. Activate application spoke, and plug‑ins as needed
• Correct because before using an Application‑based trigger in Flow Designer, you must ensure the application spoke is activated.
• Spokes contain the triggers and actions dedicated to specific applications. Without activating the spoke (and any required plug‑ins), the trigger will not be available in Flow Designer.
• This is the required step for enabling application‑based triggers.
Incorrect
Option A. Activate application trigger spoke
• Incorrect because there is no separate “application trigger spoke.” The correct requirement is activating the application spoke itself.
Option B. Assign Application trigger role [sn_app_trigger_write] to SME
• Incorrect because roles grant permissions but do not enable triggers. The trigger functionality depends on the spoke and plug‑ins being activated, not on assigning this role.
Option D. Activate application plugins only
• Incorrect because activating plug‑ins alone is insufficient. You must activate the application spoke as well, since that contains the trigger definitions.
Option E. Activate trigger security rules
• Incorrect because security rules control access but do not enable the availability of application‑based triggers.

questions.question: Which of the following modules can be used to view knowledge content?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. Self‑Service > Knowledge
• Correct because this is the primary module in ServiceNow where end users can access and view knowledge articles.
• It provides a user‑friendly interface for searching and browsing knowledge content.
• This aligns with the CSA exam expectation that knowledge content is accessed through the Self‑Service > Knowledge module.
Incorrect
Option B. Self‑Service > Knowledge Bases
• Incorrect because this module is used to manage knowledge bases, not directly to view knowledge content.
• It is more administrative in nature rather than end‑user focused.
Option C. Service Desk > Articles
• Incorrect because there is no standard ServiceNow module called Service Desk > Articles.
• This option is misleading and not valid in the CSA exam context.
Option D. Knowledge > Content
• Incorrect because while there are modules under Knowledge Management, the correct way to view content is via Self‑Service > Knowledge, not a “Knowledge > Content” module.
Option E. Service Desk > Knowledge Bases
• Incorrect because this is not a valid ServiceNow navigation path.
• Knowledge bases are managed under Knowledge Management, not under Service Desk.

questions.question: Which module can be used to manage record numbers?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option E. System Definition > Number Maintenance
• Correct because the Number Maintenance module is the official ServiceNow feature used to manage record numbering.
• Administrators can configure prefixes (e.g., INC for incidents), number length, and the next available number.
• This ensures consistency across tables like Incident, Problem, Change, etc.
• Example: Setting the incident prefix to INC ensures records are created as INC0001234.
Incorrect
Option A. System Definition > Numbering
• Incorrect because there is no module named Numbering in ServiceNow. This is a distractor option.
Option B. System Definition > Number Configuration
• Incorrect because ServiceNow does not provide a module called Number Configuration. Numbering is managed through Number Maintenance, not a configuration module.
Option C. System Dictionary > Numbers
• Incorrect because the System Dictionary defines table and field metadata. It does not manage record numbering.
Option D. System Dictionary > Number Scripts
• Incorrect because there is no such module as Number Scripts in the System Dictionary. This is another distractor option.

questions.question: Delegated developers automatically get the admin role
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. False
• Correct because delegated developers do not automatically receive the admin role.
• The delegated_developer role allows scoped application development without granting full system administrator privileges.
• This ensures adherence to the principle of least privilege, giving developers only the permissions they need to build and customize applications.
• The admin role is much broader, granting unrestricted access across the platform, which is not automatically assigned to delegated developers.
Incorrect
Option B. TRUE
• Incorrect because delegated developers are explicitly designed to avoid requiring the admin role.
• Assigning admin by default would defeat the purpose of delegated development, which is to empower developers while maintaining system security boundaries.

questions.question: ATF can consist of steps that run on web browser
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. True
• Correct because the Automated Test Framework (ATF) in ServiceNow supports steps that run directly in a web browser.
• These steps simulate user interactions such as navigating forms, clicking buttons, and validating UI elements.
• This allows testing of client-side functionality and ensures that the ServiceNow instance behaves correctly from an end-user perspective.
Incorrect
Option B. FALSE
• Incorrect because ATF is explicitly designed to include browser-based test steps.
• Denying this capability ignores one of ATF’s core features: validating both server-side logic and client-side UI behavior.

questions.question: Which module can be used to create assignment rules?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option C. System Policy > Rules > Assignments
• Correct because in ServiceNow, assignment rules are created under the System Policy > Rules > Assignment module.
• This is where administrators define rules that automatically assign tasks (like incidents, problems, or change requests) to specific users or groups based on conditions.
• It is the official and correct path for creating assignment rules in the CSA exam context.
Incorrect
Option A. System > Assignment Rules
• Incorrect because there is no direct module named “System > Assignment Rules.”
• This option is misleading and does not exist in the ServiceNow navigation.
Option B. System Policy > Assignment Rules
• Incorrect because while it looks close to the correct answer, the actual navigation path includes Rules > Assignment.
• “System Policy > Assignment Rules” is not the correct module name.
Option D. System > Rules > Assignments
• Incorrect because the correct path is under System Policy, not just “System.”
• This option omits the “Policy” part of the navigation, making it invalid.

questions.question: Which module can be used for branding?
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. System Properties > Basic Configuration UI16
• Correct because the Basic Configuration UI16 module is specifically designed for branding in ServiceNow.

• Incorrect because there is no dedicated Branding module in ServiceNow.

questions.question: Which module can be used to access catalogs?
options: Service Catalog > Catalog Definitions > Maintain Catalogs

questions.question: Which of the following modules should be used to create CI relationships?

Correct

questions.question: Which module can be used to access catalog items?

• Incorrect because this is not a valid navigation path in ServiceNow.
• It does not exist as a standalone module for accessing catalog items.

questions.question: One of the important features in Now Platform is that it is specialized to specific departments.
questions.explanation:
Correct
Option A. False
• Correct because the Now Platform is not specialized to specific departments.
• Instead, it is designed as a generalized enterprise platform that supports workflows across multiple departments such as IT, HR, Customer Service, and Security.
• Its strength lies in being cross‑functional, enabling organizations to unify processes and data across the enterprise rather than being siloed into one department.
Incorrect

• While applications can be tailored for departmental use, the platform itself is extensible and enterprise‑wide.
